requirement: Repeating conversion of an already-upgraded record MUST leave the file unchanged.
rationale:
The requirement has one obligation: converting an already-upgraded record a second time MUST leave the file unchanged.

`src/evidence_format.rs#mod[tests]/fn[loading_is_read_only_and_conversion_is_in_place_idempotent_and_preserves_failures]` carries a `{test}` reference to `requirements.sdk.habeas.evidence_conversion.idempotent` and covers it:
- It writes a legacy record and calls `convert_file` once. It asserts `assert_ne!(after, before)`, so the record really was upgraded.
- It records the upgraded bytes and the file's modification time, then calls `convert_file` a second time on the upgraded record.
- It asserts the bytes still equal the upgraded bytes (`assert_eq!(read, after)`). It also asserts the modification time is unchanged, which shows the file was not rewritten at all, not merely rewritten with identical content.

The implementation (`fn[convert_file]`) has a separate branch for an already-versioned record: it validates the record and returns `Ok(())` without writing. The test reaches exactly that branch on the second call.

The malformed-file part of the test concerns other requirements, not this one. The input class that matters here is a legacy record converted and then converted again, and that class is covered. Nothing else in the text needs a test.
